title: Properties
description: Extract text properties from the input. Requires WrangleWorks Account.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: The specific type of properties to extract.

parameters.name: first_element
parameters.description: Get the first element from results.

parameters.name: char
parameters.description: Character to use when output_format is concatenate.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Extract categorical properties from unstructured text, such as colours or materials. Requires WrangleWorks Account. ## Migrated examples #### Extracting All Properties ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - extract.properties: input: water bottles output: properties ```
##### Input Sample _No sample available._
##### Output Sample | Products | Product Properties | | --- | --- | | Stainless Steel Blue Bottle | \{'Colours': ['Blue'], 'Materials': ['Stainless Steel']\} | | Plastic Yellow Bottle | \{'Colours': ['Yellow'], 'Materials': ['Plastic']\} |
#### Extracting Colour ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - extract.properties: input: water bottles output: properties property_type: colours # Optional ```
##### Input Sample _No sample available._
##### Output Sample | Products | Product Colours | | --- | --- | | Stainless Steel Blue Bottle | ['Blue'] | | Plastic Yellow Bottle | ['Yellow'] |
